BackstoryDef.title: hive-raised juvenile
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew within the hierarchy and biological infrastructure of a Wraith Hive. Long before [PAWN_pronoun] held formal rank, [PAWN_pronoun] learned to read threat, hunger and status as parts of everyday survival.

BackstoryDef.title: living-ship ward
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] matured aboard living Wraith vessels, learning their responsive membranes, cultivated systems and biological maintenance by observation and necessity.

BackstoryDef.title: feeding ward
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] early years around a Hive's feeding stock and caretakers, learning that prey health, Wraith hunger and rank all had consequences.

BackstoryDef.title: culling pathfinder
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] ranged ahead of culling parties, identifying prey concentrations, safe approaches and extraction routes before the main strike arrived.

BackstoryDef.title: prey stalker
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] specialised in following isolated prey beyond the protection of settlements. Long hunts taught [PAWN_objective] when to fire, when to close, and when a living captive mattered more than a corpse.

BackstoryDef.title: hive lineguard
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served where a Hive expected resistance to be strongest, holding corridors, boarding points and exposed positions while lighter hunters manoeuvred around the fight.

BackstoryDef.title: boarding warrior
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] fought in cramped ships and sealed installations where neither range nor cover lasted long. [PAWN_pronoun] became comfortable opening a fight at range and ending it at arm's length.

BackstoryDef.title: hive tactician
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] coordinated hunters, warriors and living craft for a senior Hive, translating a Queen's priorities into actions under pressure.

BackstoryDef.title: culling commander
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] led culling operations where success meant prey captured, resistance broken and valuable living craft returned intact.

BackstoryDef.title: dormancy keeper
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] maintained dormant Wraith and living Hive infrastructure through long periods when neglect could cost lives before anyone woke.

BackstoryDef.title: feeding steward
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] managed feeding reserves and the condition of living captives, balancing immediate hunger against the longer survival of the Hive.

BackstoryDef.title: lineage sovereign
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] became the political centre of a Wraith lineage, deciding where the Hive would feed, sleep, grow and make war while managing dangerous subordinates and rivals.

BackstoryDef.title: brood matriarch
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] directed the biological continuity of a Hive, combining authority with close attention to feeding, reproduction and the condition of the lineage.

BackstoryDef.title: severed culling scout
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] once scouted for a larger culling force but became separated from the Hive that gave those orders. Survival without Hive infrastructure forced [PAWN_objective] to improvise and negotiate.

BackstoryDef.title: hive defector
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] deliberately abandoned a Hive whose rule [PAWN_pronoun] could no longer accept, learning to explain Wraith needs to outsiders and survive without inherited hierarchy.

BackstoryDef.title: stranded cultivator
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] survived the loss of a Wraith outpost with damaged living technology and a working knowledge of how to keep it alive.

BackstoryDef.title: archive-born template
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s earliest coherent memories were assembled from an archived pattern and reconciled against shared synthetic knowledge. Abstract knowledge came early; individual judgement took longer.

BackstoryDef.title: constructed service pattern
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] first existed as a purpose-built pattern for maintaining advanced systems. Continued experience broadened that narrow function into an increasingly independent identity.

BackstoryDef.title: reconstructed personality imprint
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was stabilised from an incomplete personality pattern. The missing pieces forced [PAWN_objective] to become unusually attentive to individual memory, identity and organic behaviour.

BackstoryDef.title: lattice systems architect
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] designed and repaired the physical systems through which human-form Replicators fabricate, communicate and maintain their bodies and settlements.

BackstoryDef.title: pattern fabricator
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] translated stored designs into stable physical assemblies, correcting tiny errors before they propagated through finished systems.

BackstoryDef.title: lattice enforcer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] enforced the decisions of a synthetic society against armed opposition, combining disciplined ranged fire with a nanite body's capacity for reconstruction.

BackstoryDef.title: field protector
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] protected synthetic teams while damaged bodies or critical pattern stores were recovered, becoming proficient at both fire discipline and emergency repair.

BackstoryDef.title: consensus director
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] mediated competing recommendations among independent synthetic minds and translated them into decisions others could act on quickly.

BackstoryDef.title: strategic coordinator
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] coordinated observers, defenders and machines during fast-moving operations, directing independent minds without confusing coordination with sovereign control.

BackstoryDef.title: recovery operative
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] secured damaged Asuran sites, recovered synthetic personnel and protected the technology needed to reconstruct losses under hostile conditions.

BackstoryDef.title: pattern survey operative
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] assessed unfamiliar societies and technologies for useful patterns, combining observation, technical analysis and the ability to defend [PAWN_objective].

BackstoryDef.title: covert observer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was trained to pass unnoticed through organic societies, collecting behavioural and technical information while preserving a plausible human identity.

BackstoryDef.title: identity-pattern agent
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] studied organic identities closely enough to maintain convincing social cover, treating speech, habits and biography as patterns to be learned rather than costumes to be worn.

BackstoryDef.title: continuity negotiator
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] helped a restrained human-form Replicator community survive through agreements with organic neighbours instead of unrestricted replication or conquest.

BackstoryDef.title: archive steward
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] preserved synthetic knowledge while deliberately limiting replication, treating continuity of memory and community as more important than simple numerical expansion.

BackstoryDef.title: independent pattern
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] chose to continue as an individual rather than remain continuously subordinated to collective consensus, learning to maintain [PAWN_possessive] own systems and negotiate with organic neighbours.

BackstoryDef.title: severed consensus
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] lost reliable contact with the collective that once supplied context for major decisions and adapted by becoming more self-directed and socially explicit.

BackstoryDef.title: reconstruction pilgrim
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] moved between scattered ruins seeking enough intact knowledge to rebuild a durable community, a working archive and a reason to preserve continuity.
